build.qualification: Benchmark-only source snapshot adds one harness=false bench registration; production src bytes match the working tree. Clock-free accounting is separate from timing.

timing.qualification: Sequential fixed-order timing after task-owned builds/checks completed; this does not assert desktop idleness. Five samples per mode/case; direct caller allocation excluded, owned result allocation and destruction included. Global allocator timed; tracking ledger excluded.

summary.aggregation: Geometric mean of per-case median latency ratios, nine nonempty workloads equally weighted; empty case reported separately. Lower ratio means lower observed latency. No confidence interval or universal speedup claim.

qualification: Fixed-order sequential measurements on this host, with task-owned compiler/test jobs completed before the recorded CPU barrier. No claim of desktop idleness, statistical significance, architecture independence or general unsafe speedup. Primary contains safe/all/20 isolated backends; independent rebuilt repeat contains safe/all. Allocation qualification is separate from timing. Every sample is retained.
